title: Agents
createAgentDescription: Create a new AI agent for your workspace.
selectAgent: Select an agent to view details
archivedNotice: This agent is archived. It cannot be assigned or mentioned.
archiveWarning: "{{name}}" will be archived. It won't be assignable or mentionable, but all history is preserved. You can restore it later.

runtime.register: Register a runtime before creating an agent

instructions.title: Agent Instructions
instructions.description: Define this agent's identity and working style. These instructions are injected into the agent's context for every task.
instructions.placeholder:
Define this agent's role, expertise, and working style.

Example:
You are a frontend engineer specializing in React and TypeScript.

## Working Style
- Write small, focused PRs — one commit per logical change
- Prefer composition over inheritance
- Always add unit tests for new components

## Constraints
- Do not modify shared/ types without explicit approval
- Follow the existing component patterns in features/

skills.description: Workspace skills assigned to this agent.
skills.localRuntimeNote: Local runtime skills (from your CLI's skills directory) are always available automatically — no need to add them here.
skills.emptyDescription: Add workspace skills to share team knowledge with this agent. Local skills are already used automatically.
skills.selectSkill: Select a skill to assign to this agent.
skills.allAssigned: All workspace skills are already assigned.

tasks.taskQueueDescription: Issues assigned to this agent and their execution status.
tasks.assignPrompt: Assign an issue to this agent to get started.

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Injected into the agent process at launch (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL)
env.readOnlyDescription: Injected into the agent process at launch. Values are hidden — only the agent owner or workspace admin can view and edit them.

customArgs.title: Custom Arguments
customArgs.description: Additional CLI arguments appended to the agent command at launch (e.g. --model claude-sonnet-4-20250514)
